thought: The Slack action_2 fails because the params are not set, causing the workflow to have issues and abort. The Slack action requires specific params: 'select' to specify sending to a channel, 'channelId' with mode 'name' and value 'general', 'messageType' as 'text', and 'text' param with expression to extract the text from input_data. I will implement action_2 to set these params correctly to fix the execution error and enable sending messages to Slack channel 'general'.
plan: Set params in action_2 with 'select' as 'channel'.
Set 'text' param as expression '={{$json["text"]}}' to extract message text from input_data.
Test Slack message sending with formatted query results.
criticism: Currently, action_2 has empty params, which causes the workflow execution failure. Setting the required params properly will resolve this issue.

tool_input.comments: Send the PostgreSQL query results to Slack channel 'general', setting required params for channel, message type, and text extraction.
